description.value: Super Thai Hot Pot is a Southeast Asian-inspired restaurant on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor specialising in interactive Malatang-style hot pot, where diners handpick fresh ingredients cooked tableside in a choice of house-made broths ranging from classic Thai Tom Yum to spicy Signature Malatang. The extensive broth menu draws on Thai, Chinese, and Cantonese traditions, making it a distinctive stop for cyclists looking for a hearty, communal meal. Online ordering and delivery are available for those who prefer a quick pick-up.
